title: Mughal-E-Azam
desc: Salim, an emperor's son, falls in love with a beautiful courtesan. Even though he is determined to be with her, his father decides to break them apart.

title: Mard
desc: King Azad is imprisoned by the ambitious General Dyer, who seizes his kingdom. Years later, Azad's son rises to challenge Dyer's tyranny and reclaim his rightful legacy.

title: Gopi Kishan
desc: Policeman Gopi's lookalike Kishan, a crook, exploits the resemblance to pursue his goals and find his father, bringing unexpected chaos and benefits into Gopi's life.

title: Honeymoon Travels Pvt. Ltd
desc: Six newly married couples unravel secrets about their respective spouses and also resolve their issues and mend their sorrows.

title: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
desc: Rohan Khanna moves to the US for work and finds himself torn between Pooja and Loveleen. Eventually, he realises his heart belongs to Pooja and returns to her.

title: AB Tumhare Hawale Watan Saathiyo
desc: Kunal reluctantly joins the army to uphold his family's legacy but soon faces ruthless terrorists threatening Indo-Pak peace, pushing him to rise and protect his nation.

title: Kurukshetra
desc: ACP Prithviraj, an honest officer, arrests Chief Minister Baburao's son for rape. In retaliation, Baburao spares no effort to take vengeance against Prithviraj.

title: Apna Sapna Money Money
desc: Satyabol opposes his daughter Shivani's love for Arjun due to religious differences. Desperate to unite with her, Arjun seeks help from his cunning cousin Kishan, leading to twists.

title: Ayassh Dil
desc: Malay is a successful journalist, but his personal life spins out of control when he gets romantically involved with several women despite being married.

title: Pyari Behna
desc: Kaali blames engineer Vinay for losing his arm in an accident and opposes his love for Seeta. As tensions rise, Vinay must face Kaali's anger to win her hand.

title: Prem
desc: Sanjay is haunted by visions of his past life as Shantanu. His world shifts when he meets Sonia, who resembles a woman from his visions, drawing him into a mysterious fate.

title: Krrish
desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.

title: Agent Vinod
desc: Agent Vinod uncovers a chilling truth: his colleague's death was orchestrated by a powerful business elite. As tensions rise, he must navigate danger to seek justice and uncover the conspiracy.

title: Saheb Biwi Aur Gangster 3
desc: After returning from jail, Aditya seeks to reclaim his political legacy, but his encounter with London based gangster Uday sparks a fierce battle for power and survival.

title: The Bhootnii
desc: Heartbroken Shantanu seeks true love under the Virgin Tree, but things spiral when Mohabbat, a lovestruck ghost, begins obsessing over him and turns his life upside down.

title: Goodbye
desc: A family unravels after the sudden death of the mother. As the children rush home for her final rites, clashing opinions ignite tensions, exposing deep-rooted conflicts.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.
